Win in [[Alliance Battles]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Win 2 Alliance Battles.
* *BONUS* Win an Alliance Battle by at least 200 points.
* *BONUS* Win 6 Alliance Battles.
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
*1,000 [[Gold]]
*7,500 [[Imperial faction|Imperial Faction]]
*Complete the Base Objective for 25 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
*Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.
*Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
See [[Alliance battle]].

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Zaishen Combat
:''"The [[Alliance]]s you form make you stronger. [[Balthazar]]'s gaze is upon the Luxon-Kurzick Alliance Battles. Win his favor by winning at least two battles before you return to Zehnchu."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I can do that!
| decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
| ask = More competitors needed to prove their mettle in combat. Travel to the battlegrounds if you have what it takes to triumph.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zehnchu
:''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

==Notes==
*The most efficient method to gain Zaishen coins is if you can consistently get the first bonus within the first two wins, then turn in the quest and retake. 
{{anomaly|Though the quest says "at least 200 points", the first bonus actually requires victory by ''more than'' 200 points.}}

==Trivia==
*Alliance Battles began awarding Imperial faction instead of [[Kurzick faction|Kurzick]] or [[Luxon faction]] after the [[Feedback:Game updates/20110602|June 2, 2011 update]]; however, this quest did not switch to awarding Imperial faction until after the [[Feedback:Game updates/20110609|June 9, 2011 update]].
